item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and most of your choices are made before you're hungry. So decide now what your next meal is, and make it something real, with protein and something green. Skipping meals or grabbing whatever's closest usually leads to a rough evening. Eat slowly and notice when you're full. Your action: before this hour ends, plan your next meal and put the ingredients where you can see them.
